title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18
lineage: MC > CD > EAC > WAV > SHN, FOB w/ two Sennheiser MD-441's (8 1/2' Stand) > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell MX-90 Cassettes w/ Dolby B). A->D (Ohr): Master Cassette > Nakamichi Dragon > HHB CDR 830 Plus > EAC -> CD Wave> flip splice

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a sun‑blazed Ventura show highlighted by a soaring Crazy Fingers and a fiery Loser.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear board sound that lets the ocean breeze and crowd ambience shine through, while the performance itself is a high‑energy beach party. Phil’s bass is on fire from the opening, Jerry wails with remarkable solos, and the set erupts when Crazy Fingers returns after years, followed by a smoking Loser and a sweet Satisfaction / Brokedown encore.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic reviews praise both the musical firepower (especially Phil, Jerry and Crazy Fingers) and the clean soundboard source; no significant technical flaws are reported.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear board mix with pleasant beach ambience; reviewers note it captures the stage view and crowd without noticeable drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Beach‑side vibe carries through a tight first set into an ecstatic second set; the surprise return of Crazy Fingers ignites the crowd and leads into a powerful Loser, ending with a sweet Satisfaction/Brokedown encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's solos are described as remarkable and his tone wailing throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil is repeatedly called "on fire", "booming" and "all over it" from start to finish.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s rhythm guitar meshes with guest John Cipollina during the second set; no specific criticism noted.
